name: Fall from height
description: Worker may fall from ladder or roof edge due to unstable access.
existingControls: Use certified ladder, pre-use inspection, spotter present

name: Dropped object
description: Tools or materials may fall from elevated location.
existingControls: Toe boards, tool lanyards, exclusion zone

name: Musculoskeletal strain
description: Improper lifting posture during repetitive manual handling.
existingControls: Manual handling training, team lift, trolley use

name: Electric shock
description: Contact with live conductors during panel work.

name: Slip or trip
description: Uneven surfaces and loose cables in work area.
consequences: Sprains, bruises, minor to moderate injuries
